nodes.label: Cotizaciones module (quote wizard + PDF + Gmail)
nodes.rationale: Wizard de 5 pasos (Cliente, Propiedad, Precios, Forma de pago, Ejecutivo) que recopila datos, calcula precios finales y dividendos, genera un PDF con @react-pdf/renderer y abre Gmail con el correo prellenado para enviar la cotización al cliente.

nodes.label: Editable legal pages pattern (Supabase + fallback HTML)
nodes.rationale: Legal pages (Política de Privacidad, Condiciones del Servicio, Eliminación de Datos) query paginas_legales by slug and fall back to an embedded FALLBACK_ES HTML string if the row does not yet exist or the query fails, so the page is never left blank while content is being migrated to Supabase-managed CMS.

nodes.label: El Barranco cross-sell banner pattern
nodes.rationale: PropiedadDetailPage hardcodes the property id 'eccfd92d-713e-4e0a-a074-ff76daffd81e' to conditionally render ElBarrancoBanner (top and bottom) which links to the dedicated /el-barranco showcase page, used to promote the El Barranco hotel listing with a richer bilingual landing experience.
